**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 already contains a vendor insurance clause that meets or exceeds our preferred position:

| Requirement | Preferred | Section 18.1 |
|---|---|---|
| CGL | USD 1M / 2M | USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate ✓ |
| Professional (E&O) | USD 2M | USD 2M ✓ |
| Cyber/privacy | USD 5M | USD 5M ✓ |
| Workers' comp | As required by law | As required by law (plus employer's liability USD 1M) ✓ |
| Certificates | On request | On request (§ 18.2) ✓ |

Additional points in our favor: coverage runs for the term **plus one year**, at Vendor's own expense; policies are primary to our insurance where customary; and § 18.2 confirms insurance does **not** limit Vendor's liabilities, so the Section 21 cap and Excluded Claims regime is preserved.

The cyber requirement is properly triggered here — Vendor processes Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17, so the USD 5M layer is live rather than conditional.

One item I noted and deliberately did not flag: § 18.2 qualifies cancellation/material-reduction notice with "to the extent available from its insurer." That is a customary market qualifier, is not part of our stated position, and does not justify a redline on a low-severity rule.
